claim: does the closed-loop PLL (design/top/top.sch -- VCO + PFD/charge pump + loop filter + divider, issue #28), driven from a cold start (RESETB power-on, VCTRL starting at whatever the loop filter's own initial condition is), lock its output to N * Fref = 25 * 10 MHz = 250 MHz within this manifest's transient window, across the full PVT corner matrix (tt/ss/ff x -40/27/125 degC x 1.62/1.80/1.98 V -- the same grid sim/pll uses, taken from spec/target-spec.md row 1's DRAFT supply range; see this record's own methodology note for that row's ratification status at record time). This supersedes sim/pll's own 200 ns plumbing-only claim as the closed-loop lock measurement issue #52 asks for -- sim/pll itself keeps its narrower plumbing claim (does xschem+ngspice+sky130 run this DUT to completion at all), unedited, per CLAUDE.md's append-only rule.
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/top/top.sch, the real four-block closed-loop PLL (not a throwaway circuit) -- straps NSEL[5:0]=011000 (N=25) and drives REF with a 10 MHz clock and RESETB with a power-on reset pwl, identically to sim/pll/testbench/tb_pll.sch, per sim/pll-lock/testbench/tb_pll_lock.sch's own header comment. `require_lock` is false: a point that completes but never locks is recorded as evidence (no lock within this window, at this corner -- see sim/harness/measure.py's lock criterion), not as a harness failure, because 'the loop does not lock within N microseconds at this corner' is exactly the kind of design fact this campaign exists to surface, and a v1 canary with an undocumented Icp-vs-loop-filter-vs-Kvco coordination gap (see design/top/DESIGN.md's own 'Coordination note') is not assumed to lock going in. A gated pass/fail on lock is a decision for the future ratifying DR once loop bandwidth/lock-time (rows 6/8) are argued from this record.
analysis: cold-start transient, closed loop (`tran 200p 3u`, injected by sim/harness/measure.py from this manifest's own measure block -- see sim/pll-lock/testbench/tb_pll_lock.sch's header comment for why the schematic itself carries no .tran card)
